title: How much spending money do I need for Vietnam?
paragraphs: Food is an important feature of a trip abroad for many of us - but what you spend can vary significantly depending on where you purchase your meals in Vietnam. As you might expect, buying food from local markets and stores can be one of the cheapest options, or you could choose to eat at mid-range restaurants, or sample some high-end establishments.
Here's an example of how much a meal costs in Vietnam based on different restaurant types.
